title: Exercise Addiction (Compulsive Exercise)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from exercise addiction, also known
as compulsive exercise or excessive exercise. Recovery is a journey of restoring balance, honoring your
body's need for both movement and rest, healing your relationship with exercise, and embracing self-worth
that is not based on performance or appearance. These affirmations encourage self-compassion, body
respect, emotional awareness, and sustainable well-being. They are intended to complement professional
medical care, therapy, nutritional guidance, and support from trusted healthcare providers.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Exercise is a valuable part of a healthy lifestyle, but true wellness includes adequate rest, proper
nutrition, emotional health, and recovery. If exercise has become compulsive or is causing physical
injury, emotional distress, or interfering with daily life, seeking support from a healthcare
professional, therapist, or registered dietitian can help restore balance. Healing is not about doing
more-it is about caring for yourself more wisely and compassionately.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by my appearance, my fitness level, or the number of hours I exercise. I am defined
by my courage to care for myself with balance, wisdom, and compassion. Every day I choose recovery,
I strengthen my body through both movement and rest, nurture my mind with kindness, and build a
healthier relationship with myself. One choice, one day, and one step at a time, I am creating a life of
balance, freedom, vitality, and lasting well-being.

What support do you still want?
